**Conventions**

- Materials for one unit only; prices exclude VAT and shipping.
- Labour, 3D-printer time, soldering jigs, NAS, workstation, incubator, consumables (microplates) and a standard IEC C13 power cord are not included.
- The 3 mm indicator LED and resistor on the bottom PCB are not included (no invoice; under 0.50 CHF).
- Items sold in minimum quantities (PCBs, SMD parts) are counted per unit, i.e. order cost divided by the number of boards.
- 3D-printed parts are costed as sliced filament mass times the price per kg.
- Converted to EUR at ECB reference rates of 2026-09-29 (1 EUR = 0.9461 CHF = 1.1355 USD).
- Source: *invoice* = price actually paid; *list* = public price on the given date; *estimate* = no quote found.
